verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no API version identifiers, versioned endpoints, or any documented deprecation policy for Chroma. The OpenAPI spec probe only shows that an API description exists. The 'Forking — Dataset versioning' feature versions data, not APIs, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
